description: Discover the best hotels in Zakynthos, Greece. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Opulent Five-Star Greek Island Villa Oasis with Private Beach, Three Restaurants & Rejuvenating Spa
hotels.description: An oasis of coastal opulence set on a magical private stretch of beach in one of Zakynthos’ most beautiful secluded bays, Porto Zante Villas & Spa is a stunning sight to behold. Providing five-star elegance around every corner, this boutique luxury resort boasts an array of award-winning private villas, each with unique views of the picturesque Ionian Sea. With modern stylings and supremely comfortable interior and exterior living spaces, unwind in the lush private garden, on the sun deck or in the spacious lounge and dining areas. Dine on your choice of exquisite Greek or tantalizing Asian cuisine at the resort’s restaurant offerings, indulge in a much-needed, rejuvenating massage at the onsite spa and toast to a holiday like no other with a refreshing waterfront cocktail.

hotels.title: Greek Island Adults-Only Pool Suites with Sea Views, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Dinner
hotels.description: Experience the epitome of Greek luxury at this haven of tranquillity set on the picturesque island of Zakynthos. This stunning adults-only property offers guests a taste of the Mediterranean lifestyle with spacious suites boasting a private pool and terrace, bohemian decor and breathtaking views of the Ionian Sea. This Greek paradise is a picture-perfect setting to begin your fairytale holiday. Venture out to hidden coves, historical villages and the renowned Shipwreck Beach. Once you’ve finished exploring, savour traditional Greek cuisine at Noya Restaurant or sip cocktails by your private pool as you soak up the serene surroundings.

hotels.title: Greek Island Modern Beachfront Haven with Eight Restaurants, Three Bars & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Set on the sweeping shores of Zakynthos comes this modern beachfront escape, inspired by the island's sparkling coast and soaring mountain ranges. From the private balcony of each minimalist suite, you'll see right out to the sparkling waters of the Ionian Sea. When it comes to dining, you're set with eight restaurants and three bars, as well as a decadent spa and dazzling outdoor pool. The resort is right on the shores of Laganas Beach, so take a dip in the sparkling waters whenever you please. When adventure calls, visit the Blue Caves, explore the Askos Stone Park, stop by one of the island's many churches or take a stroll around Zakynthos Town.

hotels.title: Greek Islands Zakynthos Wellness Escape with Daily Breakfast, Resort Pool & Four Dining Venues
hotels.description: Set above the shimmering waters of Tsilivi on the northeastern coast of Zakynthos - Zante as it's fondly known - Lesante Classic Luxury Hotel & Spa captures everything the Ionian Islands do best. Lush greenery, blue skies, sea views and an unhurried pace define the experience from arrival. The hotel's four dining venues keep things interesting well beyond breakfast. Elysian Restaurant serves lunch and dinner in smart-casual surrounds, the Palm Bar is the spot for long afternoons poolside, and The Pavilion Bar brings a sophisticated edge to evenings, staying lively until late. Beyond the table, the Lesante Spa offers healing escapes for body and mind, while private yachting excursions give guests the chance to discover Zakynthos from the sea - including its famous sea turtle nesting beaches and the ethereal Blue Caves along the island's northern coast.
